requests.prompt:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP.

WHAT THIS IS
A 2D sprite animation of the exact character in the attached first-frame image, preserving his exact face, proportions, hair, outfit, accessories, and hand-drawn colored pencil and ink caricature style throughout every frame.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND
Locked static camera with zero movement. The character stays facing left with his feet planted on the exact same spot on a flat, solid pure magenta background with no shadows, lighting changes, or visual effects. Silent clip.

MOTION: DUCK
From his starting relaxed stance, he quickly squats straight down once right where he stands, both hands on top of his head, as if something is flying over him, while both feet stay flat on the ground. Without repeating the duck, he pops back up and returns to his starting relaxed stance, holding it for the rest of the clip.
